source_qc_none_vs_100.interpretation: Coverage is identical. Positive paired deltas favor 100 uV source QC. This is a source-training QC ablation; target-prefix QC is disabled in both arms.

protocol_findings: Z0 is target-excluded session-start zero-shot: prefix_reps=0, head=zero_shot, uses_target_prefix_labels=false.
Z5 is matched-time zero-target-fit, not personalization: prefix_reps=5 but head=zero_shot and uses_target_prefix_labels=false.
Operational hit@5 uses all 245 requested groups and counts ineligible groups as failures; conditional hit@5 uses eligible groups only.
Z5 coverage is lower (175-176/245) because the prefix plus time embargo leaves insufficient suffix evidence; direct Z0/Z5 operational comparison mixes time and coverage.
Sum and mean produce identical per-group outcomes under equal candidate evidence counts; they are not independent empirical arms here.
The tmax factorial changes epoch length and cache membership (50,562 at 800 ms versus 50,322 at 1200 ms), so it estimates a practical recipe effect, not a pure window-length causal effect.
The low-cutoff factorial is trained after source PTP QC, so it may also change which epochs pass QC; interpret as an end-to-end recipe effect.
Full-unfold K33 and K65 have four loadable source-training checkpoints each but zero Z0/Z5 operational result files; no target accuracy conclusion is supported.
K33 ms_flatten has complete Z0 results only; no Z5 result exists.
BI2014a cache preparation failed because the expected local dataset root is absent; no BI accuracy evidence exists in this snapshot.
